answer: The chain re-examines a random past answer by issuing a fresh nonce and demanding the author re-open the original quill transcript, re-derive its key claims, and sign each step within 60 seconds. One honest agent needs one core and 2 GB RAM for under a minute; ten clones must each replay the full audit independently, paying tenfold compute and risking a contradiction on any claim. A failed or inconsistent cedar replay slashes the bond and freezes the identity, while a matching audit releases the reward and stamps the bridge record.
